paragraphs.text: Let love of the brethren continue.
paragraphs.original: Ἡ φιλαδελφία μενέτω.
paragraphs.translit: Hē philadelphia menetō.

paragraphs.text: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
paragraphs.original: τῆς φιλοξενίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, διὰ ταύτης γὰρ ἔλαθόν τινες ξενίσαντες ἀγγέλους.
paragraphs.translit: tēs philoxenias mē epilanthanesthe, dia tautēs gar elathon tines xenisantes angelous.

paragraphs.text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are illtreated, as being yourselves also in the body.
paragraphs.original: μιμνῄσκεσθε τῶν δεσμίων ὡς συνδεδεμένοι, τῶν κακουχουμένων ὡς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὄντες ἐν σώματι.
paragraphs.translit: mimnēskesthe tōn desmiōn hōs syndedemenoi, tōn kakouchoumenōn hōs kai autoi ontes en sōmati.

paragraphs.text: [Let] marriage [be] had in honor among all, and [let] the bed [be] undefiled: for fornicators and adulterers God will judge.
paragraphs.original: τίμιος ὁ γάμος ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ ἡ κοίτη ἀμίαντος, πόρνους γὰρ καὶ μοιχοὺς κρινεῖ ὁ θεός.
paragraphs.translit: timios ho gamos en pasin kai hē koitē amiantos, pornous gar kai moichous krinei ho theos.

paragraphs.text: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.
paragraphs.original: ἀφιλάργυρος ὁ τρόπος· ἀρκούμενοι τοῖς παροῦσιν· αὐτὸς γὰρ εἴρηκεν· Οὐ μή σε ἀνῶ οὐδʼ οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω·
paragraphs.translit: aphilargyros ho tropos· arkoumenoi tois parousin· autos gar eirēken· Ou mē se anō oudʼ ou mē se enkatalipō·

paragraphs.text: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: What shall man do unto me?
paragraphs.original: ὥστε θαρροῦντας ἡμᾶς λέγειν· Κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι· τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος;
paragraphs.translit: hōste tharrountas hēmas legein· Kyrios emoi boēthos, ou phobēthēsomai· ti poiēsei moi anthrōpos;

paragraphs.text: Remember them that had the rule over you, men that spake unto you the word of God; and considering the issue of their life, imitate their faith.
paragraphs.original: Μνημονεύετε τῶν ἡγουμένων ὑμῶν, οἵτινες ἐλάλησαν ὑμῖν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ὧν ἀναθεωροῦντες τὴν ἔκβασιν τῆς ἀναστροφῆς μιμεῖσθε τὴν πίστιν.
paragraphs.translit: Mnēmoneuete tōn hēgoumenōn hymōn, hoitines elalēsan hymin ton logon tou theou, hōn anatheōrountes tēn ekbasin tēs anastrophēs mimeisthe tēn pistin.

paragraphs.text: Jesus Christ [is] the same yesterday and to-day, [yea] and for ever.
paragraphs.original: Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐχθὲς καὶ σήμερον ὁ αὐτός, καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας.
paragraphs.translit: Iēsous Christos echthes kai sēmeron ho autos, kai eis tous aiōnas.

paragraphs.text: Be not carried away by divers and strange teachings: for it is good that the heart be established by grace; not by meats, wherein they that occupied themselves were not profited.
paragraphs.original: διδαχαῖς ποικίλαις καὶ ξέναις μὴ παραφέρεσθε· καλὸν γὰρ χάριτι βεβαιοῦσθαι τὴν καρδίαν, οὐ βρώμασιν, ἐν οἷς οὐκ ὠφελήθησαν οἱ περιπατοῦντες.
paragraphs.translit: didachais poikilais kai xenais mē parapheresthe· kalon gar chariti bebaiousthai tēn kardian, ou brōmasin, en hois ouk ōphelēthēsan hoi peripatountes.

paragraphs.text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.
paragraphs.original: ἔχομεν θυσιαστήριον ἐξ οὗ φαγεῖν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἐξουσίαν οἱ τῇ σκηνῇ λατρεύοντες.
paragraphs.translit: echomen thysiastērion ex hou phagein ouk echousin exousian hoi tē skēnē latreuontes.

paragraphs.text: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest [as an offering] for sin, are burned without the camp.
paragraphs.original: ὧν γὰρ εἰσφέρεται ζῴων τὸ αἷμα περὶ ἁμαρτίας εἰς τὰ ἅγια διὰ τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, τούτων τὰ σώματα κατακαίεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς·
paragraphs.translit: hōn gar eispheretai zōōn to haima peri hamartias eis ta hagia dia tou archiereōs, toutōn ta sōmata katakaietai exō tēs parembolēs·

paragraphs.text: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered without the gate.
paragraphs.original: διὸ καὶ Ἰησοῦς, ἵνα ἁγιάσῃ διὰ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος τὸν λαόν, ἔξω τῆς πύλης ἔπαθεν.
paragraphs.translit: dio kai Iēsous, hina hagiasē dia tou idiou haimatos ton laon, exō tēs pylēs epathen.

paragraphs.text: Let us therefore go forth unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
paragraphs.original: τοίνυν ἐξερχώμεθα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτοῦ φέροντες.
paragraphs.translit: toinyn exerchōmetha pros auton exō tēs parembolēs, ton oneidismon autou pherontes.

paragraphs.text: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after [the city] which is to come.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ὧδε μένουσαν πόλιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν μέλλουσαν ἐπιζητοῦμεν·
paragraphs.translit: ou gar echomen hōde menousan polin, alla tēn mellousan epizētoumen·

paragraphs.text: Through him then let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which make confession to his name.
paragraphs.original: διʼ αὐτοῦ οὖν ἀναφέρωμεν θυσίαν αἰνέσεως διὰ παντὸς τῷ θεῷ, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν καρπὸν χειλέων ὁμολογούντων τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: diʼ autou oun anapherōmen thysian aineseōs dia pantos tō theō, toutʼ estin karpon cheileōn homologountōn tō onomati autou.

paragraphs.text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
paragraphs.original: τῆς δὲ εὐποιΐας καὶ κοινωνίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, τοιαύταις γὰρ θυσίαις εὐαρεστεῖται ὁ θεός.
paragraphs.translit: tēs de eupoiias kai koinōnias mē epilanthanesthe, toiautais gar thysiais euaresteitai ho theos.

paragraphs.text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit [to them]: for they watch in behalf of your souls, as they that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not with grief: for this [were] unprofitable for you.
paragraphs.original: Πείθεσθε τοῖς ἡγουμένοις ὑμῶν καὶ ὑπείκετε, αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀγρυπνοῦσιν ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ὡς λόγον ἀποδώσοντες, ἵνα μετὰ χαρᾶς τοῦτο ποιῶσιν καὶ μὴ στενάζοντες, ἀλυσιτελὲς γὰρ ὑμῖν τοῦτο.
paragraphs.translit: Peithesthe tois hēgoumenois hymōn kai hypeikete, autoi gar agrypnousin hyper tōn psychōn hymōn hōs logon apodōsontes, hina meta charas touto poiōsin kai mē stenazontes, alysiteles gar hymin touto.

paragraphs.text: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
paragraphs.original: Προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν, πειθόμεθα γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν, ἐν πᾶσιν καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι.
paragraphs.translit: Proseuchesthe peri hēmōn, peithometha gar hoti kalēn syneidēsin echomen, en pasin kalōs thelontes anastrephesthai.

paragraphs.text: And I exhort [you] the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
paragraphs.original: περισσοτέρως δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι ἵνα τάχιον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: perissoterōs de parakalō touto poiēsai hina tachion apokatastathō hymin.

paragraphs.text: Now the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, [even] our Lord Jesus,
paragraphs.original: Ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἐκ νεκρῶν τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων τὸν μέγαν ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης αἰωνίου, τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,
paragraphs.translit: Ho de theos tēs eirēnēs, ho anagagōn ek nekrōn ton poimena tōn probatōn ton megan en haimati diathēkēs aiōniou, ton kyrion hēmōn Iēsoun,

paragraphs.text: make you perfect in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well-pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἀγαθῷ εἰς τὸ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐν ἡμῖν τὸ εὐάρεστον ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: katartisai hymas en panti agathō eis to poiēsai to thelēma autou, poiōn en hēmin to euareston enōpion autou dia Iēsou Christou, hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas· amēn.

paragraphs.text: But I exhort you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have written unto you in few words.
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἀνέχεσθε τοῦ λόγου τῆς παρακλήσεως, καὶ γὰρ διὰ βραχέων ἐπέστειλα ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō de hymas, adelphoi, anechesthe tou logou tēs paraklēseōs, kai gar dia bracheōn epesteila hymin.

paragraphs.text: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
paragraphs.original: γινώσκετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν Τιμόθεον ἀπολελυμένον, μεθʼ οὗ ἐὰν τάχιον ἔρχηται ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: ginōskete ton adelphon hēmōn Timotheon apolelymenon, methʼ hou ean tachion erchētai opsomai hymas.

paragraphs.text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe pantas tous hēgoumenous hymōn kai pantas tous hagious. aspazontai hymas hoi apo tēs Italias.

paragraphs.text: Grace be with you all. Amen.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis meta pantōn hymōn.
